share.title: Share request
share.hint: People you share with can view the request but cannot approve or edit it.
share.confirmRemove: Revoke this share? They will no longer be able to view the request.

delegation.title: Approval delegation
delegation.hint: The delegator can still approve. Applies only to steps that allow delegation; delegates cannot act on requests they submitted.

modes.window: Act on behalf during the period
modes.handover: Hand over new requests until done

modeDesc.window: The delegate can act on every pending request (including earlier ones). Access ends with the period.
modeDesc.handover: Only requests arriving during the period. The delegate handles them until done, even after the period ends.

delegation.fromUserHint: Leave empty for your own delegation
delegation.toUserLocked: The delegate cannot be changed after creation. Create a new delegation for someone else.
delegation.modeLocked: The delegation type cannot be changed after creation. Delete this delegation and create a new one for a different type.

workflow.title: Approval workflows
workflow.name: Workflow name
workflow.priorityTip: When several workflows apply, the one for the closest department wins first, then the higher priority.

formSchema.description: Fields users fill in when creating a request. Field keys are used in workflow branch conditions (payload.<key>).
formSchema.label: Label

formSchema.optionsRequired: Select fields need at least one option

builder.paletteHint: Drag a field type onto the form, or click to append it.
builder.selectHint: Select a field on the form to edit its properties
builder.widthHint: {{span}}/12 columns. Drag the right edge of a field to resize quickly.

flow.title: Expected approval flow
flow.chooseType: Choose a request type to see its approval flow

attachmentConfig.documentsDesc: The main request file, usually the document to sign
attachmentConfig.requiredOn: At least the minimum number of files is needed to submit

attachmentConfig.dropzone: Drag files here or click to choose
attachmentConfig.notice: Changes apply to requests submitted after saving; submitted requests keep their files.

emailTemplate.previewHint: The real email rendered by the system with sample data.
emailTemplate.confirmReset: Restore this template to its default content?

emailTemplate.composeHint: Click any text in the email to edit it. To change layout, colors or add / remove blocks, use the HTML tab.
